explanation: Well-definedness statement for erdosproblems.com/651: for k ≥ 2 and every n there is N such that any N points in general position in ℝ^k contain n points in convex position, so f_k(n) is a genuine minimum. This is the higher-dimensional Erdős–Szekeres theorem (via Ramsey's theorem, as recalled in Pohoata–Zakharov's introduction). With the file's definition of general position (every ≤ k+1 points affinely independent) and ConvexIndependent for convex position, the statement is correct; the restriction k ≥ 2 is needed (in ℝ¹ no three points are in convex position). Correct.
